operator_notes.busy_gpus: Run with --allow-busy-gpus (author-approved). An idle ComfyUI process held about 425 MiB on each GPU (NVML reports ~944 MiB used per GPU with the driver reserve) at 0% utilization; it was not stopped.
operator_notes.other_process_sampling: nvidia-smi pmon every ~20 s during the run window; '-' (no activity) counted as 0
notes: Independence holds: output throughput with both GPUs loaded is within 0.2% of solo on every load (decode_c128 ~4,700 tok/s, prefill_c4 18, mixed_c64 ~1,370) and TPOT p50 within 1.5%. TTFT p50 differences (e.g. mixed_c64 GPU1 826 vs 1,024 ms) come from the synchronized first wave of a closed-loop run, not interference. Power cap 83-89% of samples in every phase.
